content: कलिः [कल्-इनि] .²1 Strife, quarrel, dissension, contention; शठ कलिरेष महांस्त्वयाद्य दत्तः <ls>Śi. 7. 55</ls>; कलिकामजित् <ls>R. 9. 33</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 23</ls>. .²2 War, battle. अविषह्यैस्तमाक्षेपैः क्षिपन्संजनयन् कलिम् . <ls>Bhāg. 10. 55. 17</ls>. .²3 The fourth age of the world, the iron age (consisting of 432,000 years of men and beginning from the 13th of February 3102 <ab>B. C.</ab>); दानमेकं कलौ युगे <ls>Ms. 1. 86</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 301</ls>; कलिवर्ज्यानि इमानि <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 Kali age personified (this Kali persecuted Nala). .²5 The worst of any class. .²6 The Bibhītaka tree. .²7 The side of a die which is marked with one point. घृतेन कलिं शिक्षामि <ls>Av. 7. 109. 1</ls>. .²8 A hero. .²9 An arrow. --{%f.%} A bud.

कलिका, -कलिः {%f.%} .²1 An unblown flower; a bud; चूतानां चिरनिर्गताऽपि कलिका बध्नाति न स्वं रजः <ls>Ś. 6. 4</ls>; किमाम्रकलिकाभङ्गमारभसे <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 6. 17</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 33</ls>. .²2 A digit. streak. .²3 The bottom or peg of the Indian lute. .²4 A king of poetic composition (akin to बिरुद).
